subject: Spatial replicates, versus repeated measures random effect on the same site?

messages.author: e9f976a46c3a6d0f
messages.subject: Spatial replicates, versus repeated measures random effect on the same site?
parts:
Dear Discussion group,

Could someone elucidate the difference between using "formula = y ~ -1 + intercept + f(spatial, model=spde, replicate=spatial.repl)", for 2 measurements at the same location, and using "formula = y ~ -1 + intercept + f(ID, model='iid') + f(spatial, model=spde)" ?

Using the second formula, one can obtain both residual variance ( transformed precision of gaussian observations) and precision for the repeated measurements, alongside the spatial variance and range. Using the first formula, the precision on repeated measures seem to be incorporated in the spatial variance?

Is one specification preferred above the other? Given I would like to use Variance_ID/(Variance_Residual + Variance_Spatial + Variance_ID) as a measure for repeatability?

best wishes and thanks in advance for any comments,
Vincent
